req.title: Return 405 for unsupported /players root method
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using DELETE on /players/ (collection).

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-036 requires HTTP 405 when DELETE is issued against the /players/ collection endpoint. The router only registers POST and GET on /players/; DELETE is not registered there (only on /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}). FastAPI/Starlette returns 405 Method Not Allowed for unregistered methods on known paths. Tests cover: (1) positive – DELETE /players/ returns exactly 405, (2) negative – GET /players/ returns 200 (valid method, same path), (3) boundary – POST /players/ returns 201/422 (another registered method, not 405), confirming 405 is method-specific. Additional tests verify the Allow header and that the status code is not 404 (path exists) nor 2xx (method rejected). Fix applied: test[7] was kind=negative with heuristic=EP which is invalid (negative tests must use NEG heuristic); changed heuristic to NEG.

tests.name: test_delete_players_collection_returns_405
preconditions: DELETE method is not registered on /players/ collection
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 405
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_delete_players_collection_returns_405():
    r = client.delete('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 405

test_delete_players_collection_returns_405()

tests.name: test_delete_players_collection_allow_header_excludes_delete
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 405
Allow header does not contain DELETE
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_delete_players_collection_allow_header_excludes_delete():
    r = client.delete('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 405
    allow = r.headers.get('allow', '')
    assert 'DELETE' not in allow.upper()

actions: Inspect Allow response header for GET and POST
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 405
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_delete_players_collection_allow_header_includes_get_post():
    r = client.delete('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 405
    allow = r.headers.get('allow', '')

    assert 'POST' in allow.upper()

tests.name: test_delete_players_squadnumber_returns_not_405
preconditions: Squad number 1 exists in the database
expected: HTTP response status code is not 405 (DELETE is valid on this sub-path)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_delete_players_squadnumber_returns_not_405():
    r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/1')
    assert r.status_code != 405
    assert r.status_code in (204, 404, 500)

test_delete_players_squadnumber_returns_not_405()
